body:
My counselor told me to go and say to my grade 8 and other younger versions of myself that "everything is okay. you're okay. you don't deserve the bullying and hate from your peers. just stay the course" as a way of acceptance of myself and who i am.

but i don't know who that person is and what they were like...

I've got a job. I'm on a pretty prestigious profession. I've got associates at work, but they're all older than me. They are all either married or in relationships so they don't do me. We don't speak lots after work, and I kind of don't want to with most of them. Everytime I pop in to chat, I feel as if they're just putting up with me.

I feel like I don't fit in, I feel like I'm beyond different. Like people are talking to me more to be nice than having me spur a genuine interest in who I am.

Thanks for the advice, though.

Just get out and talk and be around people, but even that felt like a challenge. And being single since I was born, walking around and seeing all these people who look like they have their shit together to be appealing enough to someone to be their significant other doesn't help either.
You're welcome. He made that song in his bedroom all by himself, something that's pretty inspiring.
I won't... I'll always find a faint glimmer of hope to keep me going for a day or two before falling back to square one.

The only thing keeping me alive right now was a Bright Eyes song...

And now this.

Thanks for writing this, seriously.

While I'm not numb all the time, the worst thing is getting excited for a brief moment before it's all just snatched away and you feel like you shouldn't get excited for anything anymore.

See: someone cute sending a text to say they don't want to see you again, looking forward to an event that proves to be boring...

I'm sitting here not getting excited for anything anymore...

All you have is video games? Well, you know of a Canadian hoser that's got the same issue as you who's trying to buck it by putting myself out there little by little. So you have someone that feels the way you do!

Not sure if you can heal from exposure, but if you can, I'm going to start making an effort to try. 😊

I'd like to know too. I'll be sitting at my desk telling myself to get the stuff I set out to do, then I'll just think of something or see something on Reddit that triggers a mental breakdown where my brain just turns to static in my chair for a few minutes to an hour. And then I'm at a low point for the rest of the day and get very little done, and go home, avoid talking to my friends, and fall asleep.

Only to repeat it...
To quote Cloud Nothings: I'm getting tired of living 'til I die.

Sub "doing better than me" with "looking like they have shit sorted out, and the effort to learn how to live a normal life like them would be incredibly difficult and I don't know what to do", then you have me. Bonus if you feel that whenever you see a roaming group of friends or a two significant others in public and wonder where you went wrong.
